results.title: Kloudy project templates
results.visibleText:
Kloudy Konnekt
Choose templates for your project

Use your existing account and project. These are local source templates. No model, paid provider, installation or live execution runs here.

Email lookup hint (optional)

The hint does not prove identity or expose private choices. Complete account sign-in and 2FA.

Sign in with your email account Check sign-in

Sign in in the opened tab, then choose Check sign-in here.

Existing project permissions

To return directly to your IDE, open the paired chooser link from Kloudy 0.4.8 and confirm its matching code after sign-in. Return your selection, then use receive_website_selection on that same MCP connection. An unpaired visit can download the exact manifest instead. Choices do not authorize installation, execution or spending.
